data.body: VIOLATION_FINDING: llm-review status=skipping (not failed). Pre-existing Hook Tests and Script Tests failures on main (PR #46, run 25352800446) prevent llm-review from running. The llm-review job has needs:[test-hooks,test-scripts] dependency — when those fail, llm-review is skipped. This means CI enforcement via llm-review security overlay cannot be verified while pre-existing test failures persist on main.
